highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.3 fixes WebAssembly linking for Uno 6.x apps using the Skia renderer on .NET 9 and later.

bullets.detail: Uno 6.x WebAssembly apps using the Skia renderer no longer receive the conflicting -sUSE_WEBGPU flag on .NET 9 and later, where Dawn supplies WebGPU. The flag remains enabled for .NET 8, which uses Emscripten's built-in WebGPU port.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Fixed Uno WebAssembly WebGPU linker flags for .NET 9 and later while preserving the .NET 8 configuration.
